question: The Winter Olympics games 2022 was organised by which of the following city from 4 February to 20 February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bejing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Winter Olympics games 2022 **

 
 
• The** 2022 Winter Olympics, also known as Beijing 2022 or the XXIV Olympic Winter Games**, were an international **winter multi-sport competition** that took place in **Beijing, China, and the surrounding territories from February 4 through February 20, 2022**, with competition in some events commencing on February 2.
 
• **The top country in Winter Olympics 2022:**
 
 
• **Norway has won the most medals** at the Winter Olympics 2022 in Beijing, taking **home 37 in all, including 16 golds**, to lead the medal table for the second consecutive Winter Olympics.
 
• A **new record for the most gold medals won at a single Winter Olympics** has been set.
 
• **China**, the host country,** came in third with 15 medals**, while **Germany came in second with 27 total medals**.
 
 
 
• **India at the 2022 Winter Olympics:**
 
 
• **Arif Khan, a male alpine skier**, was the only member of the** Indian team to compete**.
 
• He carried the **national flag during the opening ceremony**, and a volunteer carried it during the closing ceremony.
 
• At the games,** India was unable to bring home any medals**.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** 2022 Winter Olympic Games' award ceremony took place at Beijing's National Stadium**, also referred to as the Bird's Nest, on February 20, 2022.
 
• The Games included **109 events in all, spread over 15 disciplines, in 7 different sports**.
 
• The Game's venues were spread up **among three zones: Beijing, Yanqing, and Zhangjiakou**. 
 
• For the** 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, the Games' Presidency has officially been transferred**. 
 
• Beijing is on track to **make history by being the first city to ever host both the summer and winter Olympics**.
